cases.name: Chong Un Kim
cases.about: In 1981, Kim relocated to the US from Korea and lived in Hinesville near Fort Stewart before her death.
cases.caseStatus: COLD CASE UNSOLVED; FORENSIC INVESTIGATIVE GENETIC GENEALOGY ID'D HER
cases.narrative: On 2/14/1988, her body was found wrapped with plastic and duct tape, was found inside a large, nylon suitcase that had been placed in a dumpster just north of Millen, GA. She has been dead for about 7 days.
